notes.title: Bonez Devlog February 23, 2024
notes.content:
Hello again Friends!

We're thrilled to announce the latest addition to the Bonez online gaming experience – the Daily Rewards feature!

[h3]Daily Reward[/h3]

Our team has been hard at work to implement this feature and add a retention mechanic for existing players. In our online version of the game, every player can now unlock incredible rewards by simply logging into the game on a daily basis. The rewards progressively increase with each consecutive day, offering a unique incentive for players to keep their daily streak alive.

Our goal with this feature was to add an extra layer of excitement to the gameplay experience, rewarding player dedication and commitment. Players can win Bonez and power cards with each daily reward. The randomness we have programmed into the prize payouts means that each time a player returns, they will receive a different prize.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44768263/a477df4decf7e9f2c1c80ffe276aa0cff27bc0c6.png[/img]

Stay tuned for more updates, and as always, thank you for being a crucial part of the Bonez community!

That's all for today!

Don't forget to add Bonez to your wishlists so you get notified when it launches on Steam!

notes.title: Bonez Devlog December 1, 2023
notes.content:
Hello Friends!

As we gear up for the upcoming launch, fine-tuning the balance and finishing a few small details, let's take a moment to reflect on the UI updates we have implemented in the past few weeks of development.

[h3]UI Overhaul[/h3]

Our design team undertook the task of updating the original UI design of the game to provide a sharper, more intuitive interface for players. An adjusted colour pallet and background design provided increased contrast and simpler game play. 

Moving opponent power cards to the top of the game board allowed for better ease of use for viewing and dragging your own power cards. 

Several special effects were also added which provide a new level of excitement when playing power cards. Players can also enjoy a status of being "on fire" when they win 2 consecutive rounds. These little enhancements have really added a flair to the game that we feel was missing in previous versions.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44768263/a5ee580aed3b2adf0cff40e6f98b4be47388a0cd.png[/img]

That's all for today!

Don't forget to add Bonez to your wishlists so you get notified when it launches!
